title: Grouped boxplot
intent: Compare three raw value distributions using quartiles, medians, whiskers, and outliers.

ai.create: Create vertical boxplots for three groups from raw {group, value} observations. Plot may use boxY; TanStack must compose a box, median tick, whisker link, and outlier dots from D3 quantiles.
ai.maintain: Switch to horizontal boxplots while preserving the raw rows, Tukey whisker semantics, outliers, inferred types, and granular D3 imports.
